assertions.assertion: The denial is for CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring.
The denial reason code is PR-204.
The clinical indication documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1).
The clinical indication documents a recent history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9).
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate-control therapy.
